info.title: Hawker Centre Management System API
info.description: RESTful API for the Hawker Centre Management System (BED assignment). Protected endpoints require a Bearer JWT obtained from the relevant /login route.

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: Paste: Bearer <token>. Get a token from /customers/login, /stallowners/login, /operators/login, or /officers/login.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the signed-in stall owner\'s account (isActive = 0), removing it from active use while preserving linked records for referential integrity.

get.description: Returns the signed-in stall owner\'s own profile (never another user\'s, never the password hash). A soft-deleted account is refused even with a still-valid token.

403.description: Forbidden (not a stall owner, or the account is disabled).

delete.description: Soft-deletes the signed-in customer\'s account (isActive = 0), removing it from active use while preserving linked orders/reviews for referential integrity.

get.description: Returns the signed-in customer\'s own profile (never another user\'s, never the password hash). A soft-deleted account is refused even with a still-valid token.

403.description: Forbidden (not a customer, or the account is disabled).

get.description: Returns the signed-in officer\'s own profile (never another user\'s, never the password hash). A soft-deleted account is refused even with a still-valid token.

403.description: Forbidden (not an officer, or the account is disabled).

get.description: Returns the signed-in operator\'s own profile (never another user\'s, never the password hash). A soft-deleted account is refused even with a still-valid token.

403.description: Forbidden (not an operator, or the account is disabled).

put.summary: Change the logged-in user\'s email address
put.description: Any logged-in role. Confirms the current password, rejects an unchanged or already-taken email (email is unique across all accounts), then updates Users.email.

200.description: Email updated; the new email is returned.

400.description: Invalid body, or the new email is unchanged.

401.description: Unauthorized (no token) or the current password is incorrect.

put.summary: Correct or update a logged inspection
put.description: NEA officer updates an existing inspection record with a corrected score, remarks and/or inspection date, to keep official inspection data accurate.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the inspection to update.

200.description: Inspection updated; the updated record is returned.

400.description: Inspection ID is not a number, or the body failed validation.

post.description: NEA officer schedules an upcoming inspection for a specific stall on a chosen date, so they can plan their workload. The date cannot be in the past (scheduling for later today is allowed).

201.description: Inspection scheduled; the new record is returned.

400.description: Validation failed, or the scheduled date is in the past.

get.description: Returns the signed-in officer\'s scheduled (not yet completed) inspections, earliest date first, for planning.

200.description: The officer's scheduled inspections (empty list when none).

post.summary: Submit a cart as an order
post.description: Customer only. Turns one of the signed-in customer\'s carts into an order: creates the order, its line items and a payment record in a single transaction, generates a daily per-stall queue number, and clears that cart. paymentMethod is Cash, NETS or PayNow.

201.description: Order placed; returns orderID, queueNumber and totalAmount.

400.description: Validation error (missing cartID or invalid paymentMethod).

get.description: Customer only. Returns the signed-in customer\'s own orders (scoped by customerID from the JWT), newest first, each with its line items, totals, status, queue number and payment details.

200.description: The customer's orders (empty array if none).

post.summary: Submit a rating and review for a stall
post.description: Customer only. Leaves a star rating (1-5) and optional comment for a stall the customer has a completed, paid order with. One review per customer per stall. The comment is run through a profanity filter before it is stored.

201.description: Feedback submitted; returns the new feedbackID.

400.description: Validation error, or order not completed/paid.

403.description: Forbidden (not a customer, or order does not belong to you).

409.description: You have already reviewed this stall.

get.description: Customer only. Returns the signed-in customer\'s own reviews, each with the stall name, newest first. Used by the feedback page to let a customer pick a review to edit.

200.description: The customer's reviews (empty array if none).

post.description: Customer only. Updates the rating and/or comment on a review the signed-in customer owns. The updated comment is run through the profanity filter before it is stored.

403.description: Forbidden (not a customer, or review does not belong to you).

get.description: NEA officer view of complaints across every stall, newest first. Each complaint includes the stall, its hawker centre and the customer who raised it. The optional filters can be combined to narrow the list down while investigating.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: open, underReview, resolved or closed.

parameters.name: stallID
parameters.description: Filter by the stall the complaint is about.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by category: Hygiene, Service, Food Quality or Other.

200.description: Matching complaints (empty list when nothing matches).

put.summary: Record follow-up action on a complaint
put.description: Moves a complaint through open -> underReview -> resolved/closed as the officer investigates. Officers have authority over every stall, so no ownership check applies. resolvedAt is stamped when the complaint is resolved or closed, and cleared if it is reopened.

parameters.name: complaintID
parameters.description: ID of the complaint being followed up.

200.description: Status updated; the updated complaint is returned.

400.description: Complaint ID is not a number, or the status is missing/invalid.

get.summary: View which menu items I have liked
get.description: Customer only. Returns the IDs of the menu items the signed-in customer has liked, so the front-end can mark them as liked on the public stall menu.

500.description: Error retrieving your liked menu items.

post.description: Customer only. Records a like for a menu item (one like per customer per item; liking again is a no-op). Returns the item\'s new like count.

delete.description: Customer only. Removes the signed-in customer\'s like from a menu item. Returns the item\'s new like count.

get.description: Lists every promotion belonging to the signed-in stall owner\'s stall, newest first.

200.description: The stall's promotions (empty list when none exist).

404.description: No stall found for this account.

post.description: Creates a promotion for the signed-in owner\'s stall, then emails every customer who has ordered from that stall before. startDate/endDate are optional; discountType is percentage, fixed or points.

201.description: Promotion created; the new promotion plus a notifiedCustomers count is returned.

400.description: Validation failed, or the end date is before the start date.

404.description: No stall found for this account.

put.description: Updates a promotion the signed-in owner owns. Passing isActive toggles it on or off, so activation goes through this same route.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the promotion to edit.

200.description: Promotion updated; the updated promotion is returned.

400.description: Invalid ID/body, or the end date is before the start date.

403.description: Forbidden (not a stall owner, or not this owner's promotion).

delete.description: Deletes a promotion the signed-in owner owns.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the promotion to delete.

403.description: Forbidden (not a stall owner, or not this owner's promotion).

get.description: Returns every hawker centre ranked by distance from the customer\'s current location (nearest first). Each centre is geocoded via the OneMap search API; a centre OneMap cannot locate is still returned but with null coordinates/distance.

200.description: Hawker centres with coordinates and distanceKm, nearest first.

get.summary: Get directions to a hawker centre
get.description: Proxies OneMap\'s routing service (which requires an authenticated token, kept server-side) to return the distance, travel time and route line from the customer\'s location to a chosen centre.

parameters.name: routeType
parameters.description: Travel mode: walk (default), drive or cycle.

200.description: Route summary: distanceMeters, timeSeconds and an encoded route geometry.

502.description: OneMap routing unavailable (or ONEMAP credentials not configured).

get.summary: View a stall\'s ratings and reviews (public)
get.description: Public, no login required. Returns a stall\'s average rating, review count and individual reviews (rating, comment, reviewer name and timestamp), newest first, so anyone browsing can read reviews before deciding where to eat.

200.description: Object with averageRating, reviewCount and a reviews array.

400.description: Stall ID must be a number.

post.description: Stall owner only. Marks the stall\'s still-active orders (pending/preparing/ready) that were placed over 45 minutes ago as "abandoned", clearing them from the active order board for food-waste tracking. This sweep also runs automatically whenever the queue board is loaded.

200.description: Sweep done; returns the count and the abandoned orders (count may be 0).

404.description: No stall found for this account.
